instruction: Candid dance photograph, full shot. Inside a bright, minimalist ballet studio with white walls and large windows, the male dancer in a black unitard (R2) on the left and the female dancer in a black long-sleeve top and white tutu (R1) on the right perform a coordinated partner pose. They hold hands overhead and in front, with the female dancer balancing gracefully on pointe and the male dancer leaning forward. Both dancers display focused expressions. Bright, natural daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the floor.
